GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 000.5 (24 Jan 47) LS-R
(SCAPIN - 1485)
APO 500
24 January 1947
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo
SUBJECT : Apprehension of Suspected War Criminal
Memorandum to the Imperial Japanese Government dated 10 January 1947, file AG 000.5 (10 Jan 47)LS-R, (SCAPIN 1455) wherein the Imperial Japanese Government was directed to deliver one YOSHINARI, Eiji, Sgt., to the Commanding General, EIGHTH Army at Sugamo Prison (Tokyo Detention Camp), at the earliest possible date, is amended to delete said YOSHINARI's name for the reason that he is presently incarcerated in CHANGI Gaol, SINGAPORE. This name appears as the fifth name on Pago No. 5 of the above mentioned Memorandum.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
JOHN B. COOLEY,
Colonel, AGD,
Adjutant General.
